verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some programmatic pipeline management: a Warehouse Sync API for setting up warehouse ingestion (a source-side pipeline) and a Platform API for audiences. However, connecting outputs is documented as a UI flow (Data Platform > Setup > Directory, click a partner card), and nothing shows API or MCP control over destinations, connections, or delivery inspection. Missing for 10: documented API for creating sources/destinations and wiring connections, delivery/event-forwarding inspection via API, an MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.
